description: Start an order for a plan from esim_find_plans and get a checkout link for the person, for one traveler or a family pack of up to 6. Nothing is charged here. The person must open the link, confirm their phone number in NUM, and pay on Stripe themselves. Ask the person before calling this.

destination.description: The same destination used to find the plan.

travelers.description: How many people need an eSIM on this plan (a family pack): one checkout, one eSIM per phone, each with its own install link. 3 or more people save 5% each, 5 or more save 8%. Defaults to 1.

name: esim_start_checkout
title: Start eSIM checkout
